author: val
body: `display-init-text-fallback` hands the browser a DisplayState with `ds-active` False, so `display-present` is a no-op: the browser never touches the Bochs VBE ports and never writes 0xBF000000, and the desk's framebuffer stays the only scanout. The pane walks `browser-render`'s tree straight to `base`/`stride` and skips the 786,432-element Framebuf the standalone path builds.

author: val
body: Set-1 scancodes: 29/157 left Ctrl make/break, 42/170 left Shift, 54/182 right Shift, 56/184 left Alt. A Set-1 stream carries modifiers as their own make and break codes, while the browser's `map-key-event` wants a mask and compares against `key-*` constants and `char-code` values; `poll-key-decode` converts between the two alphabets.

author: val
body: An event releases the memoized tree to `bs-laid-mark` BEFORE it dispatches: the new state is allocated above the frontier, and a bump allocator cannot free underneath state that must survive. That is why `browser-click-code` answers an Integer read out of the tree while it is still alive. The restore goes below the desk's frame mark, so an event answers negative; the idle and modifier branches allocate nothing below it and answer 1.

author: val
body: `bs-laid` is the SHIFTED tree: `comp-translate-kids` stores into the nodes rather than copying them, so the painted geometry and the hit-test geometry are the same records. A repaint of the kept tree walks it through `gbr-walk` and must not translate it a second time.
